summary: The diff implements an admin-guarded manual ingestion UI route and updates the frontend to prefer backend posts while falling back to seed content. However, several backend requirements are either missing or only partially implemented based on the provided diff summary, including persistent/stable storage for posts/queue, backend query APIs for listing/fetching posts (not evidenced in main.mo snippet), automatic rewrite, deterministic categorization, true programmatic image generation/serving, and a hands-free daily scheduler. Google verification preservation and route/layout preservation cannot be fully verified from the diff summary (index.html not shown).

missing_requirements.requirement: Preserve Google Search Console verification meta tag in frontend/index.html with the same content value.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not include frontend/index.html, so there is no evidence the existing google-site-verification meta tag was preserved unchanged.
evidence: File diff summary: frontend/index.html not shown/modified

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes query methods to list posts (optionally filterable by category/state tag/search) and fetch a single post by id.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.getPublishedPostsByCategory and actor.getPostById, but the backend/main.mo snippet provided is truncated and does not show these query methods being implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Posts and processed queue persist across canister upgrades using stable storage.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows in-memory Map/List structures (posts, processedQueue, submissions, userProfiles) but the diff summary does not show stable variables, preupgrade/postupgrade hooks, or migration logic to persist the new post/queue data across upgrades.
evidence: backend/main.mo (shows let posts = Map.empty..., let processedQueue = List.empty..., no stable/persistence shown in snippet)

missing_requirements.requirement: Automatically rewrite ingested items into a student-friendly English article (simplified title, excerpt, and HTML body with headings/bullets), not a direct copy.
missing_requirements.reason: PostHelper.processRawContent appears to pass through title/excerpt/body from ingestion without evidence of rewriting, restructuring, or HTML generation logic.
evidence: backend/post-helper.mo (processRawContent returns provided title/excerpt/body without transformation)
backend/main.mo (manualIngestContent passes owner-provided fields directly into processRawContent)

missing_requirements.requirement: Automatically assign category using deterministic rules and/or validate and apply owner-provided hint with fallback to education-news.
missing_requirements.reason: manualIngestContent accepts a category string and uses it directly; no validation against allowed categories and no keyword/rule-based classification is evidenced.
evidence: backend/main.mo (manualIngestContent takes category: Text and passes it through)
backend/post-helper.mo (categoryFromContentType exists but is not evidenced as used for classification/validation)

missing_requirements.requirement: Programmatically generate and attach a relevant image per published post (SVG/PNG) within the app stack and make it retrievable by the frontend, with safe fallback if generation fails.
missing_requirements.reason: PostHelper sets imageUrl to a static path pattern ("/backend/<category>.svg"), but the diff summary provides no evidence of actual image generation, storage, or serving endpoints/files for these SVGs from the backend.

missing_requirements.requirement: Daily backend scheduler auto-publishes at least one processed item hands-free (no manual triggers/logins).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a callable method autoPublishScheduledContent gated to admins, but no evidence of a daily timer/scheduler mechanism that runs automatically is present in the summary.
evidence: backend/main.mo (autoPublishScheduledContent requires admin; no scheduling/timer shown in snippet)

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure public pages never empty via fallback behavior when no queued items exist (fallback to seed content).
missing_requirements.reason: Category pages now use combined updates (backend + seed), but useCombinedUpdates always appends seedUpdates even when backend returns some posts; the specific AC mentions fallback when backend returns zero for a category. The diff does not show logic to avoid empty states in all relevant places (e.g., StatePage still shows an empty message when no state-tagged updates exist).

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a safe upgrade path (migration only if needed) ensuring existing contact submissions/user profiles remain intact and new post/queue state persists across upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not show explicit preupgrade/postupgrade handling or stable state definitions to preserve both existing and newly-added structures across upgrades.
